notes.title: Dog In A Box Update (5/2/19)
notes.content:
Update time!
First of all, for those who have bought Dog In A Box, we'd like to extend a huge thanks!  

We're working hard on adding more features and more dogs to make an even more fun experience!  In the meantime, here's a few fixes to some issues we noticed.

  Fixed an issue where the Switch View button did not work in main menu
 Changed the colour of the screen on the Volcano to make the text more readable (sorry about the cyan!)

If you have any feature suggestions or issues of your own, let us know via our contact form at stackinteractive.io or Tweet us @StackInteract!
